description:
LANDED 394fcfc59 on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. BOTH ORIGINAL
GAPS WERE WITHDRAWN ON MEASUREMENT during scoping; what landed is the defect
that measurement found in their place.

WITHDRAWN, with evidence: threading a PlanSite into surface_membership::
observe had no subject -- 605 fixtures x 11 settings = 6,655 runs report ZERO
escapes, because fz-kdt.179 cured the population, and the abort backtrace
already names the plan KIND through five distinct debug frames. Reading the
unreadable question variants bought the denominator and no finding: a
prototype that read List / TupleArity / Equal / MapKind / Bitstring for
separation moved plans read 79 -> 210 and pairs examined 87 -> 218 while
blind-escape findings stayed 0 -> 0 at four arrivals, because Region::List is
Empty | Cons and Region::TupleArity is an arity -- NEITHER CARRIES A TYPE,
and the census's relation is surface x emitted test.

THE DEFECT THAT LANDED: a tripwire census row that OBSERVES NOTHING read zero
and passed, so its 0 meant "nothing was looked at" rather than "no escapes".
An OBSERVATIONS counter is now bumped in observe before the escaped call,
saved/restored/exposed on SurfaceMembershipCensus; SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS
is a 4-tuple (fixture, setting, observations, escapes); and the gate asserts
observations > 0 FIRST, before pinning either number.

RED-FIRST: the gate failed at head naming exactly seven rows -- 00277_enum_
tier0_fixture at settled, arms:6, wrappers:1, wrappers:6 and wrappers:reverse,
and enum_predicate_search at settled and arms:6. Counts at head: 375/375
(00420, enum_take_drop_split), 36 each (00183, 00230, 00419), 6 each (00418,
unused_range_binding), 4 (dispatch_list_head_separates), 0 on the seven.

CAUSE VERIFIED FROM --dump backend=, not assumed: 00277 publishes five
wrappers and enum_predicate_search thirty-two, ALL single-member with no
selection block, so select_construction_member takes the
`None if members.len() == 1` branch and no dispatch runs. Both observe 0 at
EVERY arrival, so neither could be re-homed onto itself.

RE-HOMED FIVE, DELETED TWO, each with the reason in the table's doc: 00277's
arms:6 and its three wrapper orders moved to behavior/enum_take_drop_split at
the same four arrivals (375 observations each; 23 of its 38 wrappers are
multi-member with a selection plan, verified). enum_predicate_search's arms:6
moved to 00419_enum_take_mixed under arms:6 (36; all four wrappers two-member
with a selection plan) because fz-kdt.183's cure was about list arms differing
at the ELEMENT. The two SETTLED rows were DELETED rather than re-homed: the
settled arrival is already held by six settled rows, so re-homing would have
added a duplicate row, not kept a property.

COST, CORRECTED: the ticket said the gate is ~20 s and does not grow. It goes
26.8 s -> 37.1 s CPU, because the re-homed arrivals compile enum_take_drop_
split (38 wrappers) where the blind rows compiled 00277 (5). Stated in the
commit message. Net across this ticket, fz-kdt.196 and fz-kdt.193 is still
strongly negative.

GATE: Coordinator gate on the folded branch (marker COORD-GATE-1788477267): fmt clean, zero build warnings, clippy clean, doctests clean, lib 1710 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored in 86.6 s, fixture matrix single-threaded 509 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored.

comments.text: BOTH GAPS ARE NOW PINNED NUMBERS (fz-kdt.178, 8de517a28). (1) SOURCE_ORDER_PLANS_ON_THE_CENSUS pins (kind, plans, unreadable): entry 144 / 137, case 3 / 3, receive 2 / 0 (the refuter found the case and receive plan kinds the first cut missed); the unreadable variants are Region::List, TupleArity, Guard, Equal, printed by the census gate; SOURCE_ORDER_BLIND_ESCAPES reads 0 over the readable ones. Reading Region::List and TupleArity (shape tests) would bring most of the unreadable entries into the census. (2) The dynamic report's missing site is stated in dispatch-matrix.md and SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS's doc: the static census names ten escaping wrappers on 00277 (w10, w11, w20 with four members; w13-w19 with eleven) and the twelve dynamic escapes cannot be attributed among them until observe prints its PlanSite.

title: The dynamic tripwire prints no plan site and the static census silently skips 82.5% of entry plans: name the wrapper/callsite in the escape report and read Region::List questions
